title: Lovely Studio @Margaritaville Nashville
description:
You won’t have to head all the way to the Caribbean to find your lost shaker of salt. In fact, it’s right upstairs at the resort’s rooftop bar. Lounge poolside until the sun hangs low, take it easy by the fire pit, and see panoramic views of downtown as live music loosens your mood.

Other things to note
Valet parking on-site is available for $42 per night. Self-parking is not available at this resort. Prices are subject to change.
